parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: SDGIds
parameters.description: The IDs of SDGs that you want to query. By default, all SDGs are queried.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens describe-sdg --sdg-ids sdg-1 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --same-disk-id true --region cn-hangzhou
